How this tester works

Two models, one datasetAn Isolation Forest scores how unusual your reading is, then a Random Forest of 200 trees predicts the risk. Both learned from the 1,000 readings of the Kaggle Water Leak dataset (public domain).
Runs in your browserThe trained trees are built into this page, so every answer is computed instantly on your device.
Risk labelsHigh means a burst, medium means a leak or an anomaly score above 0.4, and low is everything else.

HydroWatch AI · IHRD College of Engineering, Attingal. This is a student project for learning, not a tool for real pipeline decisions. Only 10 of the 1,000 readings are high risk, so high-risk answers are the least certain. In testing, the model reached about 97% accuracy with 5-fold cross-validation.
